scripts.build:servers: pnpm --parallel --aggregate-output --dir UndauntedMetagame run build --dir UndauntedDeployServer run build
scripts.build:all: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$server = Start-Process pnpm -ArgumentList 'run','build:servers' -NoNewWindow -PassThru; $internal = Start-Process pnpm -ArgumentList 'run','build:internal' -NoNewWindow -PassThru; Wait-Process -InputObject $server,$internal; if ($server.ExitCode -ne 0 -or $internal.ExitCode -ne 0) { exit 1 }"
